message.subject: feat: Implement cart management API and frontend integration
message.body: - Added CartsRepository for managing cart persistence and operations. - Created CartsController to handle API requests for cart creation, retrieval, addition, update, and removal of items. - Defined Cart and CartItem models to represent cart structure and items. - Implemented unit tests for CartsRepository to ensure correct behavior under various scenarios. - Developed frontend API integration for cart operations, including fetching, adding, updating, and removing items. - Created Cart component to display cart contents and handle user interactions. - Added e2e tests to validate cart functionality and persistence across sessions. - Introduced database migration for cart and cart_items tables. - Updated HTTP request definitions for cart operations.
